FROM [Teachers] AS [t]

    SELECT [c].[ClassesId], [c].[TeachersId], [c0].[Id], [c0].[ClassroomId], [c0].[CourseId], [c0].[Day], [c0].[EndTime], [c0].[LabroomId], [c0].[Level], [c0].[Section], [c0].[SessionalId], [c0].[StartTime], [c0].[Term], [c0].[WeekType]

) AS [l0]

        FROM [TeacherTeacherAssignment] AS [t0]
        INNER JOIN [Teachers] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TeachersId] = [t1].[Id]

) AS [l0]

    SELECT [t].[Id], [t].[CourseId], [t].[LevelTermSectionId], [t].[SessionalId], [s].[AssignedSectionsId], [s].[TeachersId], [s].[Id] AS [Id0], [s].[Code], [s].[Designation], [s].[Name]

        SELECT [t0].[AssignedSectionsId], [t0].[TeachersId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Code], [t1].[Designation], [t1].[Name]

) AS [l0]

        FROM [TeacherTeacherAssignment] AS [t0]
        INNER JOIN [Teachers] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TeachersId] = [t1].[Id]

FROM (

    FROM [LevelTermSections] AS [l]
    WHERE [l].[Level] = @__schedulingState_Level_0 AND [l].[Term] = @__schedulingState_Term_1 AND [l].[Section] = @__schedulingState_Section_2
) AS [l0]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [t].[Id], [t].[CourseId], [t].[LevelTermSectionId], [t].[SessionalId], [s].[AssignedSectionsId], [s].[TeachersId], [s].[Id] AS [Id0], [s].[Code], [s].[Designation], [s].[Name]
    FROM [TeacherAssignments] AS [t]
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT [t0].[AssignedSectionsId], [t0].[TeachersId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Code], [t1].[Designation], [t1].[Name]
        FROM [TeacherTeacherAssignment] AS [t0]
        INNER JOIN [Teachers] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TeachersId] = [t1].[Id]
    ) AS [s] ON [t].[Id] = [s].[AssignedSectionsId]
) AS [s0] ON [l0].[Id] = [s0].[LevelTermSectionId]

    FROM [LevelTermSections] AS [l]
    WHERE [l].[Level] = @__schedulingState_Level_0 AND [l].[Term] = @__schedulingState_Term_1 AND [l].[Section] = @__schedulingState_Section_2
) AS [l0]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [t].[Id], [t].[CourseId], [t].[LevelTermSectionId], [t].[SessionalId], [s].[AssignedSectionsId], [s].[TeachersId], [s].[Id] AS [Id0], [s].[Code], [s].[Designation], [s].[Name]
    FROM [TeacherAssignments] AS [t]
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT [t0].[AssignedSectionsId], [t0].[TeachersId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Code], [t1].[Designation], [t1].[Name]
        FROM [TeacherTeacherAssignment] AS [t0]
        INNER JOIN [Teachers] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TeachersId] = [t1].[Id]
    ) AS [s] ON [t].[Id] = [s].[AssignedSectionsId]
) AS [s0] ON [l0].[Id] = [s0].[LevelTermSectionId]

FROM (

    FROM [LevelTermSections] AS [l]
    WHERE [l].[Level] = @__schedulingState_Level_0 AND [l].[Term] = @__schedulingState_Term_1 AND [l].[Section] = @__schedulingState_Section_2
) AS [l0]

    SELECT [t].[Id], [t].[CourseId], [t].[LevelTermSectionId], [t].[SessionalId], [s].[AssignedSectionsId], [s].[TeachersId], [s].[Id] AS [Id0], [s].[Code], [s].[Designation], [s].[Name]

FROM (

    FROM [LevelTermSections] AS [l]
    WHERE [l].[Level] = @__schedulingState_Level_0 AND [l].[Term] = @__schedulingState_Term_1 AND [l].[Section] = @__schedulingState_Section_2
) AS [l0]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [t].[Id], [t].[CourseId], [t].[LevelTermSectionId], [t].[SessionalId], [s].[AssignedSectionsId], [s].[TeachersId], [s].[Id] AS [Id0], [s].[Code], [s].[Designation], [s].[Name]
    FROM [TeacherAssignments] AS [t]
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT [t0].[AssignedSectionsId], [t0].[TeachersId], [t1].[Id], [t1].[Code], [t1].[Designation], [t1].[Name]
        FROM [TeacherTeacherAssignment] AS [t0]
        INNER JOIN [Teachers] AS [t1] ON [t0].[TeachersId] = [t1].[Id]
    ) AS [s] ON [t].[Id] = [s].[AssignedSectionsId]
) AS [s0] ON [l0].[Id] = [s0].[LevelTermSectionId]
ORDER BY [l0].[Id], [s0].[Id], [s0].[AssignedSectionsId], [s0].[TeachersId]
